replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Not really. My low neuroticism score (13) means I handle stress well. Math feels like a puzzle to solve, not a threat. I focus on what I can control, like breaking problems into smaller steps, which helps me stay calm and confident.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: Yes, I used an AI tool last year to check my algebra homework. It explained steps clearly and caught my mistakes. It was helpful but I still preferred working through problems myself first to build my understanding.

Find the derivative f'(x), set it equal to zero, and solve for x. Plug those x-values back into f(x) to get the y-coordinates. Check if they're maxima or minima using the second derivative test. This helps identify where the function changes direction.
